titre: Share a task list with your team on Coche
description:
Share a task list with your team on Coche (invite link): join the space, paste the list address, then send the link.

Chapters
00:00 Join a space and open "Invite"
00:12 Paste the list address and copy the link
00:24 Send the link to your team

Summary
1. In Spaces, ask to join your team's space. Once your request is accepted, you are a "Member".
2. In the menu, under Tools, open "Invite".
3. Paste the list address. The space is recognized automatically.
4. Your invite link shows up right away, no button to click. Copy it in one click.
5. Send it to your team: one click is all it takes to join the list.

Full docs:
https://coche.example/doc/invite

#Coche #productivity #tutorial
